Thanks for submitting a bug report. When submitting an issue please:
- **Save any stacks into a file first**, then attach the file to the issue. Issues with entire stacks copy/pasted into the comments are difficult to navigate. 
- **Include the content of the About>Git Commit IDs on the initial bug report** This helps the developer know which version of the product you are using. 
- **Add helpful screenshots of the problem**
- **Erase this reminder text**

Thanks, 
The JfP team
